Chongqing is a vibrant city that offers a mix of modern and traditional experiences.
Not only can you delve into unique shopping opportunities, but discovering the Impressions @ Wulong performance directed by Zhang Yimou is a must for art enthusiasts.
The Three Natural Bridges are breathtaking natural formations where movie buffs can appreciate the filming location of 'Bumblebee'.
Additionally, be sure to enjoy the picturesque landscape of the Youyang Taohuayuan, a serene retreat known for its beautiful scenery.
Gongtan Ancient Town provides a glimpse into Chongqing’s rich history with majestic views and traditional architecture.
For an authentic cultural experience, don’t miss the chance to savor tea brewed in a traditional round stove!
These attractions, along with the Chiyou Jiuli Ancient City, make Chongqing a gem worth exploring.
